context.stage: WF-01 Step 2 REWORK 1 — Fix TD-UI-03 normative language + AC3

task.description:
WF-01 Step 2 REWORK 1: Fix the two issues in TD-UI-03 found by REQ-VALIDATOR.

Issue 1 (MAJOR): In the summary table, TD-UI-03's description uses 'SHALL' twice but the priority is SHOULD. RFC 2119: SHALL = MUST. Replace both 'SHALL' occurrences in the TD-UI-03 table row with 'SHOULD'.

Issue 2 (MINOR): AC3 says 'no flash of generic or untitled workspace' — not reliably captured by a static Playwright screenshot. Replace with: 'A Playwright screenshot taken on the first authenticated route after OIDC callback completion shows the correct tenant display_name — no untitled or generic placeholder text is present.'

Make only these two targeted edits. Do not change TD-UI-01, TD-UI-02, or any other part of the file.

Complete handoff with PASS, next_action='Route to REQ-VALIDATOR (Step 2 re-check)'.
acceptance_criteria: TD-UI-03 table description uses SHOULD, not SHALL
TD-UI-03 AC3 is testable via Playwright screenshot

result.summary: Fixed TD-UI-03: replaced both SHALL with SHOULD in summary table, replaced AC3 with Playwright-verifiable criterion.
